public_rationale: Tech Times reported on June 16, 2026 that Microsoft paid OpenAI $303 million and SoftBank paid it $867 million in 2025 [e4]. The item does not provide a related-party note or payment reconciliation establishing those amounts as commercial cash receipts during calendar 2025 [e4]. It therefore does not settle the payment claim [e4].
limitations: The evidence does not distinguish cash receipts from recognized revenue, receivables, noncash consideration, or netted transactions.
It does not establish the entities included for each counterparty or independently verify the amounts.
